notes.title: Update 1.2.1 - Burnland Part 2
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Kings![/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652845/86fb0d52095f7e8227cdfd30b6fbd41b3af6f5b5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652845/f84221e63bb8df9f1f9ebc28a99906787fd50256.png[/img][/url]

A new update is ready for download.
This time we are adding 3 new outposts for the Burnland map!
One of them is for the "Battle mode".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652845/44dc6f512e6348bd4290032aaf8fe1f02ae9c7e2.png[/img]

Now you can enjoy the Burnland map to the fullest and think of new tactics that will help you achieve victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652845/f3d1f4a2f3ba5271b8203bc0c009ec1630c9de3f.png[/img]

Besides expanding the Burnland map, we have fixed many bugs and issues.
This should give you smooth and seamless gameplay.

Let us know what you think!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652845/4ce10d6198970f87aa354b4f858e5fdc9d15b00d.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.2 - Burnland Part 1
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652845/86fb0d52095f7e8227cdfd30b6fbd41b3af6f5b5.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652845/f84221e63bb8df9f1f9ebc28a99906787fd50256.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Greetings![/h1]

We are glad to announce our new update for Battle of Kings. With this update, we bring you a brand new map to explore called the Burnland.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652845/f3d1f4a2f3ba5271b8203bc0c009ec1630c9de3f.png[/img]

Burnland is a different environment theme with lots of new possible winning strategies. Our new map is characterized by a large volcanic zone with bridges, barricades, and mines. There are structures and walls of hardened lava with dragon bones and skulls left around along with hot steaming lava streams beneath.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652845/44dc6f512e6348bd4290032aaf8fe1f02ae9c7e2.png[/img]

You can try this map on the campaign mode playing first and second Outpost. Let us know what you think about it and stay tuned for more!

[h1]See you on the battlefield![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652845/26df674799373a6f3a9a038994c131c72019ce9d.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Hello, 

[h1]We have a small update with some bugfixes:[/h1]

- Fixed active controllers (such as the Xbox controller) clashing with mouse controls causing cursor blinking
- Fixed some units sent in multiplayer Battle mode disappearing shortly after being spawned
- Fixed wrong material on lanterns

We hope you are enjoying the game. If there is something you want to share with us, you can use our discussions.

See you on the battlegrounds!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hi Guys, we hope you are enjoying the game.

Be sure to try the Battle mode as it is very addictive and fun in multiplayer.

Here are some things that we have fixed today so they don't disturb with enjoying the game.

[list]
[*]Fixed rematch button not working
[*]Adjusted borders on battle levels so that players cant clip the camera into rocks surrounding the map
[*]Added missing shadows to some objects on Desert battle
[*]Fixed battle messages having differing styles
[*]Removed redundant hint for skipping lector messages
[*]Fixed loading screen not being shown to players joining a match.
[/list]

If you have some feedback or if you are experiencing some bug, please share it with us on the pinned discussion thread.

Thanks for supporting the game.
